title: At The Beach
author: Drorgo
description: You are at a beautiful Thai beach, looking for your lost book, on your quest you meet a few local people and explore the beach you are at.  This is a classical 80s-like text-based adventure, with multiple states per each location - this is my 1st game, developed with TWINE, inspired by the very first text-based quests I played at the last millennium :-) I hope you'll like it.
